componentAssignment: Source-only separated clusters: local Y > 1000 labels A, otherwise B; no image assigns a component.

method.grouping: Only full finite triangle edges with near-identical endpoints; exact binding positions remain unchanged. No inferred infinite intersection or partial collinear overlap.
method.planeClassification: Existing hashed source plane normals: abs(nZ)<.02 wall; .02<=abs(nZ)<.99 sloped; otherwise horizontal. These are orientation classes, not accepted roof semantics.
method.uvComparison: Raw decoded first UV channel at both grouped endpoints; no wrapping or native raster assumption.

imageObservationRoles.family: apparent back/side wall and roof/wall transitions
imageObservationRoles.role: exploratory candidate only; excluded from fit and heldout
retrospective semantic diagnostic; historical descriptor roles unchanged; not new blind heldout

imageObservationRoles.family: timber rails, roof bright mark, photographic beams/stains
imageObservationRoles.role: appearance only; excluded from physical boundary constraints

limits: Triangle topology contains duplicate vertices and near-equal decoded coordinates; grouping tolerance is explicit and exact bindings retained.
Full-edge inventory can miss T-junctions or partial overlapping edges; unpaired edges are not proof of a geometric hole.
A wall/sloped plane incidence is a source candidate, not proof the image displays it or that it is an interior roof boundary.
UV discontinuity need not yield a visible boundary; a texture line can exist without a mesh edge.
No camera, component image assignment, native lighting or V12/V14 acceptance established.
